title: Stop renting your MS Office apps and get a permanent license for your Mac for $89.97
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Get Microsoft Office Home & Business 2021 for Mac for $89.97 (MSRP $219) with a one-time license and no subscription or renewal fees.

If recurring software costs are eating into your budget, a lifetime Office license can be a simpler way to handle the essentials. Microsoft Office Home & Business 2021 for Mac gives you permanent access to the classic Office apps with one upfront payment. The license is available for $89.97 (MSRP $219), with no subscription or renewal fees to worry about.

Included apps:

  • Word
  • Excel
  • PowerPoint
  • Outlook
  • Teams (basic)
  • OneNote (free version)

That’s basically everything you need to handle work projects, personal tasks, or school assignments like a pro. It’s perfect for students, families, or small business owners who want a dependable, full-featured productivity suite without ongoing costs.

Once you purchase, you’ll get instant delivery of your redemption code via email, along with instructions to activate it. The license connects to your Microsoft Account (not your device), and it works on one Mac for the lifetime of the product. It also comes with updates and free customer service.

Just make sure you redeem the code within 7 days of purchase, and note that this version is not compatible with virtual machines like Parallels Pro.

Skip the subscriptions — get a lifetime license to Microsoft Office Home & Business for Mac 2021 while this $89.97 deal lasts.
